game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Remanentnano
quote:
The game is good, but I hate everything it represents: 
-No physical format.
-Paid early-access trailers.
-$80 for an incomplete game—and even if they claim it’s "just cosmetics," it’s a disgrace that the content exists within my game yet remains inaccessible unless I pay an extra $20. 
-It’s full of bugs that pull you right out of the experience.
-Features boring characters pushed by a "woke" agenda.
-Despite boasting about being "super realistic"—all they’ve managed to do is make the flaws in the animations stand out even more.

author: Remanentnano
quote: The game is unplayable due to glitches, bugs and poor optimisation, I paid for an incomplete game.
